bio: When Malice planted Atrophax the Demon Tree, the Royal Conclave of the Eldrin could have abandoned their lands to save their people. They refused. Eldathir is the embodiment of that mandate – to fight for their homes, to fight to the end, to fight to the last living soul. To never surrender.
